rule.title: RESTful Plural Nouns and Kebab-Case Endpoints
rule.statement: REST API URI paths must use plural nouns in kebab-case for resource collections and avoid verbs in URI paths.
rule.rationale: Verbs in URLs duplicate HTTP method semantics (GET, POST, DELETE) and violate REST standard uniform resource identification.

source.book_title: Design and Build Great Web APIs
source.chapter: Chapter 3: Designing Web APIs: A Seven-Step Process
source.evidence_quote: URIs identify resources, not actions. By convention, resource collections are named with plural nouns to represent sets of entities, and HTTP verbs operate on those resources.
